scope: Read-only audit of seven currently accepted adjacent publication edges, preserving primary metrics, original pilots, completed sensitivity attachments and adverse slices. No bootstrap rerun, new scoring, model training or acceptance change.

primary_summary.interpretation: Currently 3/7 (42.86%) primary losses are strictly within1–3%; the preference for a majority is not achieved. Even if the only remaining D37 edge is accepted and in range,4/8 is exactly half, not a strict majority. The mean near1.96% does not change these counts. The3.11836% edge stays outside the interval; primary metrics are never replaced by pilot/combined/full results.

stability_assessment.judgment: Seven positive primary points are established, but this is not seven equally strong demonstrations of stability. The third edge has a nearly null/mixed pilot, and the fifth/sixth depend on small full-population effects after adaptive expansion. These limitations must remain explicit in the final chain assessment.

global_limitations: Pilot and replication UIDs are disjoint within a pair, but use the same trained models/date; users and models recur across pairs and the original30000 cohort was already evaluated. No independent retraining seed or untouched temporal confirmation is established.

Recipes, endpoints, publication interval and some sample sizes were chosen adaptively during development. Nominal paired UID-cluster95% intervals (seed17,2000 draws) do not correct for sequential looks, candidate selection or multiple slices.

Request-macro observed-positive NDCG@10 is primary. Requests without positives and inactive selected users remain coverage counts but are outside the metric denominator; full logged candidates are retained within eligible requests.

The first primary is originalfull30000; remaining primaries are fixed8192. Unweighted selected-edge means are descriptive and cannot substitute for each edge's evidence or the preferred-range proportion.
Slice CI overlap with zero is reported, not converted into a new universal significance gate. Positive overall points or aggregate means are not by themselves a stability proof.
Matched causal-prefix cache snapshots do not establish persistent-cache/FIFO-serving behavior or isolate release-window length as a causal factor.
No failed or weak candidate was replaced or deleted by this review; experiment_log.json remains the complete exploration record.

pending_terminal_window.required: Actual endpoint completion, fixed whole-day scoring/audits, declared follow-up evidence and an explicit final stability/effect-size plus remaining-window/data-exhaustion review.
